description: List every item (question or stimulus) in a New Quiz (LTI), in quiz order, returning each item's id, position, points_possible, entry_type, and full entry body — including interaction_data and scoring_data, so the correct answer is visible in the result. Find the assignment_id with list_assignments or get_assignment, filtered on is_quiz_lti_assignment (not a Classic Quiz ID). Use get_new_quiz_item to refetch a single item by id, create_new_quiz_item to add one, update_new_quiz_item to change one, and delete_new_quiz_item to remove one. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating.

assignment_id.description: The assignment ID of the New Quiz
